title: Characters / available Unreal coverage
summary: The project currently contains Manny and Quinn as engine template placeholders. The owner character sources have no verified corresponding Unreal assets. This category makes that missing coverage explicit.

items.title: Owner character species / Unreal coverage missing
items.body:
**Coverage gap, not a new production request.** The stage-2 catalog contains nine saved character blends under `Characters/<species>/<variant>/Blender/`. The current project registry has no matching imported fantasy-character skeletal assets. `/Game/Art/Characters` remains the confirmed future destination and has not been created here.

No character was invented, generated or imported for this library. Manny and Quinn above are existing engine placeholders. Chicken and Tongue Mop remain cleaning-tool references in Assets. See [File rules](FILE_PLACEMENT.md) for the existing source/export audit. Review date: 2026-11-17.
